import os
base='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485747/attempts/18dbe85446804b4a9d8265837008f502/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(base,exist_ok=True)
p=base+'/task-2736de97.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for row in out:
        marks = [i for i, value in enumerate(row) if value != 0]
        for left, right in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
            for col in range(left + 1, right):
                if row[col] == 0:
                    row[col] = 2
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
test=[[0,0,6,0,0,0,0,0,6],[0,6,0,6,0,0,0,6,0],[6,0,0,0,6,0,6,0,0],[0,0,0,0,0,6,0,0,0]]
exec(code)
print(transform(test))
